g.text: alice_demo>
/history
[you] Hi, I'm Alice and I'm allergic to peanuts. I live in Berlin.
[bot] Nice to meet you, Alice! I've noted that you're allergic to peanuts and that you live in Berlin. How
can I assist you today?
[you] What time is it in Tokyo right now?
[bot] The current time in Tokyo is 11:54 PM on Sunday, October 11th. If you need anything else, just let me
know!
[you] Convert 250 USD to INR
[bot] 250 USD is approximately 24,207.42 INR at the current exchange rate. If you have any more questions or
need further assistance, feel free to ask!
[you] Convert 5 miles to kilometers and 72 F to C
[bot] Here are the conversions:
- 5 miles is approximately 8.05 kilometers.
- 72°F is approximately 22.22°C.
If you need anything else, just let me know!
[you] Search the web: what is the latest stable Python version?
[bot] The latest stable version of Python is **3.14**, which was officially released on **October 7, 2025**.
This version will be supported until October 2030. If you have any other questions or need further
information, feel free to ask!
[you] Look up the IP address and location for example.com
[bot] The IP addresses for example.com are:
- **104.20.23.154** (Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada, ISP: Cloudflare, Inc.)
If you need more information or assistance, just let me know!
[you] Draft a short email to my landlord asking to fix the heater. Key points: broken since Monday,
apartment 4B.
[bot] Here's a draft for your email to the landlord:
**Subject:** Request for Heater Repair in Apartment 4B
Dear [Landlord's Name],
I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inform you that the heater in my apartment (4B) has been
broken since Monday.
Could you please arrange for a repair at your earliest convenience? I appreciate your attention to this
matter.
Thank you for your assistance.
Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Contact Information]
Feel free to fill in your name and contact information, and let me know if you need any changes!
[you] Translate to Spanish: Where is the nearest pharmacy?
[bot] The translation is: **¿Dónde está la farmacia más cercana?** If you need anything else, just let me
know!
[you] Summarize this in one sentence: Retrieval-augmented generation combines a language model with an
external knowledge source. At query time the system retrieves relevant documents and feeds them to the model
as context, which reduces hallucinations and lets the model answer from fresh or private data without
retraining.
[bot] Retrieval-augmented generation integrates a language model with an external knowledge source,
retrieving relevant documents at query time to provide context, which minimizes hallucinations and allows the
model to utilize fresh or private data without retraining.
